items.title: freestylefly/awesome-gpt-image-2
items.description: Prompt as Code | GPT-Image2 工业级提示词引擎与模板库，530+ 个案例逆向工程，20+ 套工业级模板，并提炼出Skills，持续更新中
items.author: freestylefly
items.summary_zh: 这是一个面向 GPT-Image2 的开源提示词引擎与模板库，作者对 532 个案例做了逆向工程，提炼出 20+ 套工业级模板，并把可复用的写法沉淀为 Skills，以“Prompt as Code”的方式持续更新。适合需要批量、稳定产出高质量图片的开发者或内容团队，用来替代零散的手写提示词。
items.summary_en: This open-source repository is a GPT-Image2 prompt engine and template library built on "Prompt as Code." It reverse-engineers 532 real cases into 20+ industrial-grade templates and distills reusable patterns as Skills, with ongoing updates. Developers and content teams who need consistent, high-volume image generation can use it instead of ad-hoc hand-written prompts.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 作者自2025年4月起使用 Cursor，到2026年4月因 Cursor 从固定许可转为按量计费、费用更高且不可预测，公司决定改用 OpenAI Codex。体验 Codex 大半个月后，他认为 Codex 更接近真正的超级 Agent，而非只是编程助手，并觉得它更接近下一阶段形态。
items.summary_en: The author used Cursor for about a year from April 2025, then his company switched to OpenAI Codex in mid-April 2026 after Cursor moved from fixed licensing to usage-based pricing, making costs higher and unpredictable. After a bit over two weeks with Codex, he sees it as closer to a true AI agent than a coding assistant, even though he appreciated Cursor's in-editor experience. The piece is useful for developers weighing AI coding tools on cost, capability, and enterprise strategy.

items.title: [分享创造] 团队最近实现了一个名为 weft 的 chrome 插件，极大提升内容工作者的生产效率~
items.summary_zh: Weft 是一个开源 Chrome 插件，把网页/PDF 中选中的内容按 Session 保存，让 AI 只基于用户圈定的材料写报告、摘要或图表。答案引用可点击回溯原文，Deep Search 找来的外部证据则单独标记，强调可溯源的 grounded generation。适合常做调研、写稿、竞品分析的内容工作者。
items.summary_en: Weft is an open-source Chrome extension that saves selected text, images, and links from webpages and PDFs into per-topic Sessions, then lets AI generate reports, summaries, or charts only from that chosen material. Citations in answers are clickable back to sources, while evidence from Deep Search is marked separately, reinforcing grounded generation with traceability. It's for researchers, writers, and analysts who want AI output to be verifiable.

items.title: [问与答] 关于 docker desktop，遇到一个很奇怪的问题
items.summary_zh: 一位用户在 Windows 10 的 Docker Desktop 上发现，即使没有启动任何容器，vmmem 进程 CPU 占用仍持续超过 10%；关闭「Enable Scout image analysis」选项后降到 1% 以下。该问题似乎由 Scout 后台镜像分析触发，即使用户并未显式开启相关索引。遇到 Docker Desktop 空闲高 CPU 的人可尝试此选项。
items.summary_en: A Windows 10 user found vmmem consuming over 10% CPU in Docker Desktop even with no containers running. Disabling "Enable Scout image analysis" dropped usage below 1%, despite background Scout SBOM indexing not being enabled. Useful for developers seeing idle Docker Desktop CPU spikes.

items.title: [推广] 做了一个免费的 UTM Checker：上线前检查 campaign URL
items.summary_zh: UTMChecker.online 是一个免费的 campaign URL 预检工具，可检查 utm_source/medium/campaign 缺失、utm_conent 这类拼写错误、大小写混用、重复参数、UTM 放错位置、空值和双重编码。支持批量审计最多 50 个 URL，并输出可直接用于 GA4 的 CSV；付费 API 还能接入自动化 QA。适合投放、邮件或社媒团队在上线前快速排查 attribution 问题。
items.summary_en: UTMChecker.online is a free pre-launch tool that audits campaign URLs: it spots missing utm_source/medium/campaign values, typos like utm_conent, inconsistent casing, duplicate parameters, UTM after a hash, empty values, and possible double encoding. It batch-checks up to 50 URLs and generates a CSV with cleaned, GA4-ready URLs; a paid API adds automated QA. Useful for ads, newsletters, and launch teams before pushing links live.

items.title: openai/codex
items.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
items.author: openai
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 的 Codex CLI 是一个运行在本地终端的轻量级编程代理，支持 Mac/Linux 和 Windows 安装，也可作为 IDE 插件装进 VS Code、Cursor、Windsurf。对想留在命令行用 AI 写代码的开发者，它提供了比云端版本更直接的本地工作流；OpenAI 还提供桌面应用和云端 Codex Web。
items.summary_en: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally in a terminal, with installers for Mac/Linux and Windows plus IDE extensions for VS Code, Cursor, and Windsurf. It should appeal to developers who want AI pair-programming without leaving the command line; OpenAI also ships a desktop app and a cloud version, Codex Web.

items.title: [程序员] 通过定义一个内核接口层 OpenKAL，实现了 C++通用交叉编译/构建，可以在 Windows 上交叉编译 Linux 和 macos 程序 (其实更通用 在任意 OS 交叉构建到任意 OS 程序)
items.summary_zh: OpenKAL 通过定义通用内核接口层，让 C++ 可在 Windows、Linux、macOS 之间互相交叉编译，例如在 Windows 上构建 Linux/macOS 程序。项目已在 GitHub 公开，包含 openkal 规范、mcpp 构建工具和交叉构建示例。适合需要在本地为多平台目标构建 C++ 工程的开发者。
items.summary_en: OpenKAL defines a generic kernel-interface layer for C++ so it can cross-compile between Windows, Linux, and macOS — e.g., building Linux/macOS binaries from Windows. The project is on GitHub with the openkal spec, the mcpp build tool, and cross-build examples. It's useful for developers who need multi-platform C++ outputs without juggling separate toolchains.

items.title: [生活] 三线城市和村镇，养小孩成本多少的？

items.summary_en: On V2EX, the author notes that acquaintances with high incomes still struggle to support a child in international school, while classmates in Chaoshan earning only ¥6–7k a month have two or three kids. They wonder whether child-rearing costs really are that low in third-tier cities and villages. Useful as an anecdotal perspective, though no hard data is included.

items.title: JetBrains详细阐述了控制AI支出快速增长的首批举措
items.summary_zh: JetBrains 称开发相关 AI 支出六个月涨约十倍，公司没有收紧工具名单，而是构建了 Central CLI 共享访问与记账层，让请求经自有 AI 平台统一路由，可对第三方工具套用积分并为开发者/团队设限额，已有超千名开发者采用。这种思路把成本控制从事后观察变成流量必经的控制点，适合既想保留工具选择权又要控制预算的团队。
items.summary_en: JetBrains says AI-related development spending rose roughly tenfold in six months. Instead of narrowing the approved tool list, it built a Central CLI as a shared access and accounting layer: requests route through its own AI platform, letting the company apply credits and set per-developer or per-team limits. More than 1,000 developers adopted it within weeks, offering a model for teams that want both tool choice and cost control.

items.title: [推广] Claude Code / Codex 除了按量 API，月付 Seat 这种方式有人需要吗？
items.summary_zh: Qiz Origin 推出面向 Claude Code/Codex 的月付 Seat，订阅后获得 Base URL 与独立 Key 即可接入，无需维护上游账号；目前分 $38/月 Standard 和 $180/月 Premium 两档，一个 Seat 只对应一个工具，额度用尽会返回 429。这不是官方代充或 Team 邀请，适合不想按量付费或自备账号的用户，但需自行评估非官方渠道的稳定性。
items.summary_en: Qiz Origin is offering monthly seats for Claude Code or Codex: subscribers get a Base URL and independent key to plug into the existing CLI, without maintaining an upstream account. Plans are $38/month Standard and $180/month Premium, with one seat supporting only one tool; hitting usage limits returns 429. It isn't an official recharge or Team invitation, so it may appeal to those averse to per-token API billing, with third-party risks to weigh.

items.title: Cloudflare 推出 Agent Tracing：支持截断限制，不同框架的 Payload 默认记录策略存在差异
items.summary_zh: Cloudflare 发布 Agent Tracing，作为 Cloudflare Agents 的首个组件，提供统一 Dashboard 查看 Agent 会话；在 Workers Tracing 之上新增 Agent 调用、模型调用、工具执行与审批等 Span，附模型信息和 Token 用量，Subagent 调用会嵌套在父级瀑布流中。Beta 期间免费，2026 年 10 月 1 日起纳入 Workers Observability 计费，适合排查返回 200 但行为异常的 Agent。
items.summary_en: Cloudflare launched Agent Tracing, the first component of Cloudflare Agents, adding a unified dashboard for agent sessions. It extends Workers Tracing with agent-level spans for agent invocations, model calls, tool executions, and approvals, carrying model info and token usage; subagent work nests under the parent flow. Free in beta, it enters Workers Observability billing on October 1, 2026, and helps debug agents that return HTTP 200 yet misbehave through wrong tool choices or costly retries.

items.title: npm 终于动手了：默认封杀 postinstall 脚本
items.summary_zh: npm 12 发布，默认关闭 allowScripts，依赖项的 preinstall/install/postinstall 脚本（含隐式 node-gyp 构建）不再自动运行，需 approve-scripts 审批。--allow-git 与 --allow-remote 默认改为 none，弃用可绕过 2FA 的细粒度访问令牌。官方给出迁移建议，社区反应普遍正面。
items.summary_en: npm 12 ships with allowScripts disabled by default, so preinstall, install, and postinstall scripts from dependencies (including implicit node-gyp builds) won't run unless explicitly approved. It also defaults --allow-git and --allow-remote to none and deprecates fine-grained access tokens that could bypass 2FA. items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

In a test on juejin.cn, mobile adaptation was solid and UI fidelity exceeded 70%. Frontend developers who need a rapid way to convert live sites into maintainable code can use it.

items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
items.author: pbakaus
items.summary_zh: Impeccable 是一套专门为 AI 设计工具量身打造的设计语言，旨在帮助 AI 更准确地理解和生成美观、一致的用户界面。它定义了清晰的视觉规范、布局原则和交互模式，让 AI 在设计输出时不再“胡乱发挥”，而是遵循人类设计师的直觉和标准。无论是设计自动化工具、低代码平台还是智能助手，Impeccable 都能显著提升 AI 产出的设计质量，降低后期人工修正成本。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design language crafted specifically for AI-powered design tools, helping AI better understand and generate visually appealing, consistent user interfaces. By defining clear visual specifications, layout principles, and interaction patterns, it stops AI from producing chaotic results and instead aligns its output with human designer intuition. For design automation tools, low-code platforms, or smart assistants, Impeccable significantly improves the quality of AI-generated designs and reduces the need for manual adjustments.

This tool is particularly valuable for applications requiring authentic and engaging audio interactions, making voice AI more accessible and versatile.

Beyond basic tutorials, these cookbooks explore creative scenarios such as scriptwriting or debate simulation. For developers looking to push Claude's capabilities, this is an invaluable learning resource.

items.title: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日起施行，哪些信息值得关注？
items.summary_zh: 《国务院关于出境入境管理的规定》将于 9 月 15 日施行，全面替代旧版出入境法规，涉及护照、通行证签发、口岸查验及外国人停留居留规则。新规对证件办理时限作出明确要求，并统一各口岸流程。近期有出境计划、留学或涉外工作安排的人应尽快对照更新后的规定检查证件和签证。
items.summary_en: The State Council's new Regulation on Exit and Entry Administration takes effect on September 15, replacing older rules that governed passports, travel permits, border checks, and foreigners' stay and residence. It sets explicit deadlines for travel document issuance and standardizes procedures across ports. Anyone planning trips abroad, studying, or working overseas should review the updated rules well ahead of time.

items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.
